Within the vaulted caverns of the Splitspine mountain, an errant stalactite slowly scuttles along the ceiling. When it senses the tremor 
of nearby prey, a hard stone-like shell opens wide, revealing a long prehensile tongue that rolls out wetly from its maw. Gently swaying 
back and forth, the tongue feels for the slightest movement in the stale air. When an unsuspecting creature approaches, it lashes out 
with unerring accuracy, slapping against the body, gripping and reeling it into the rows of gashing teeth that line its hungry maw. 
Th is mollusk, grown large from a carnivorous diet, infests many of the Umbrawells, from tight confi nes to the largest caverns, slowly 
creeping near natural stalactites and stalagmites, and waits sometimes for weeks, before catching another careless creature.

Natural Camouflage While the mollucite remains motionless, 
it is indistinguishable from a natural cave formation, such as a 
stalagmite or stalactite. Th e mollucite has Advantage on Dexterity 
(Stealth) checks made to Hide while in the Umbrawells or equivalent 
environments.

of its distant evolutionary past. Knowing this, it is possible to

wrong prey.
